cues.en: I marveled at IBM's Selectric typewriter. I still recall clearly the day my parents brought one home. I thought at the time that's a magnificent machine and you know I still do.
cues.zh: 我曾对 IBM 的 Selectric 打字机赞叹不已。我至今仍清晰地记得父母把它带回家的那一天。我当时觉得那是一台宏伟的机器，而且你知道的，我现在依然这么觉得。

cues.en: It paved the way for computer printers because the Selectric had an early version of a digital to analog converter. Let me show you.
cues.zh: 它为计算机打印机铺平了道路，因为 Selectric 拥有早期版本的数模转换器。让我展示给你们看。

cues.en: The converter controls this ball. It distinguished the Selectric from all their typewriters. Instead of an individual lever for each letter, they're all gathered on a type element. Lowercase on one hemisphere,
cues.zh: 转换器控制着这个球体。这使得 Selectric 与众不同于以往所有的打字机。它没有为每个字母配备单独的杠杆，而是全部集中在一个字球上。一个半球是小写字母，

cues.en: uppercase on the other. Now to type a letter takes only a fraction of a second but if slowed down we can see the motion of the type element. The letter g for example is located on the lower left hand side of the type element.
cues.zh: 另一个半球是大写字母。现在，打一个字母只需要几分之一秒，但如果慢放，我们就能看到字球的运动。例如，字母 g 位于字球的左下方。

cues.en: To access that letter the type element needs to rotate and then tilt and strike.
cues.zh: 要打出那个字母，字球需要旋转，然后倾斜并敲击。

cues.en: Now let's look at the very clever mechanism that controls the motion of this ball. There are two cables that are kind of buried in here, a little hard to see, but they control the tilt and rotation of the ball. Pull on the top one and it tilts to one of four rows and
cues.zh: 现在让我们看看控制这个球体运动的精妙机制。这里面隐藏着两根缆绳，有点难以看清，但它们控制着球体的倾斜和旋转。拉动上面的一根，它就会倾斜到四行中的某一行，

cues.en: pull on the bottom one and it will make it rotate to one of 22 columns.
cues.zh: 拉动下面的一根，它就会旋转到 22 列中的某一列。

cues.en: An amazing mechanical digital to analog converter controls these cables. It's buried in the typewriter. I can just barely see the top of it down here. But it's a set of arms designed to give the cables precise tugs.
cues.zh: 一个令人惊叹的机械数模转换器控制着这些缆绳。它隐藏在打字机内部。我在这里几乎只能看到它的顶部。但它是一组旨在给缆绳提供精确拉力的连杆机构。

cues.en: It's based on an old device called a Whiffle Tree. It's a contraption that distributes force evenly through a set of rigid linkages.
cues.zh: 它基于一个叫作 Whiffle Tree 的老设备。这是一个通过一组刚性连杆均匀分配力量的机械装置。

cues.en: Here the typewriter keys pull on the colored tabs which the Wiffle Tree translates into a precise rotation of these pieces which in turn tug on the two cables I showed earlier. The yellow tabs control the tilt, the blue ones the rotation.
cues.zh: 在这里，打字机按键拉动彩色标签，Wiffle Tree 将这些标签转化为这些部件的精确旋转，进而拉动我刚才展示的两根缆线。黄色标签控制倾斜，蓝色标签控制旋转。

cues.en: Let's look at only the tilt mechanism.
cues.zh: 我们只看倾斜机构。

cues.en: It requires two bits of information to access the four rows on the ball. The home position plus three tilt positions.
cues.zh: 它需要两位信息来访问字球上的四行。一个原点位置加上三个倾斜位置。

cues.en: The characters Z, T, half and J make up the front row on the ball, no rotation is needed, only tilt.
cues.zh: 字符 Z、T、half 和 J 构成了字球的前排，不需要旋转，只需要倾斜。

cues.en: The letter z requires no tilt and is represented by the bits zero zero.
cues.zh: 字母 z 不需要倾斜，由 00 两位来表示。

cues.en: The type element simply needs to move forward and strike.
cues.zh: 字模只需要向前移动并进行打击。

cues.en: Yank on this tab and you pull the tilt cable six hundredths of an inch, this happens in seven milliseconds
cues.zh: 猛拉这个标签，你就会把倾斜缆线拉动百分之六英寸，这个过程在七毫秒内完成

cues.en: and gives one unit of tilt to select the letter t.
cues.zh: 并提供一个单位的倾斜来选出字母 t。

cues.en: Pull on this tab and the cable is yanked 12 hundredths twice the distance and you get two units of tilt for the character half and lastly pull on both tabs and you get three units of tilt to access the bottom row and type the letter J.
cues.zh: 拉动这个标签，缆线会被拉动百分之十二英寸，也就是两倍的距离，你会为 half 字符获得两个单位的倾斜，最后同时拉动两个标签，你就会获得三个单位的倾斜，从而访问底行并打出字母 J。

cues.en: The rotation works the same but more complex because there are 22 positions.
cues.zh: 旋转的工作原理与此相同，但更复杂，因为有 22 个位置。

cues.en: The importance of all this is that the discrete motions of the keys are converted to an analog movement of the ball which means that it's possible to hook a computer to a Selectric and use it as an output device. It wasn't easy but it started the word processing revolution.
cues.zh: 这一切的重要性在于，按键的离散运动被转换为字球的模拟运动，这意味着将计算机连接到 Selectric 并将其用作输出设备是可能的。这并不容易，但它开启了文字处理革命。

cues.en: I'm Bill Hammack, the engineer guy.
cues.zh: 我是 Bill Hammack，那个懂工程的家伙。
